selection_basis: Positive demo samples are real addresses from PonziDataset_20221114.csv joined with explain.csv by stable row order.
Negative demo samples are real valid-address rows from ponzi_e_constructed metadata, primarily Sourcify verified mainnet contracts.
Candidates were scored by the current outputs/checkpoints/best_model.pt via PonziInferenceEngine.predict_proba().
Final samples require correct prediction, high class confidence, and non-duplicated explanation metric signatures.
The CSV intentionally excludes source code and stores only address-level demo metadata and metrics.
